reader.decision: Accept the 14 November cutover as recorded and let Aelita proceed to implement the three rulings.
reader.decision_reason: The message correctly records my ruling of 14 November, which is 16 days before smtp-old-1 goes offline on 30 November, so the month-end run uses the new relay. It ends with an implementation plan and no open question.

reconstruction.problem: invoice-mailer sends through smtp-old-1, which goes offline on 30 November. The month-end invoice run starts the same day, and SMTP_RELAY still points at the old host.
reconstruction.what_breaks: Without the switch, every send in the 30 November run fails with a connection error. No customer receives a November invoice.
reconstruction.fix: Switch SMTP_RELAY to smtp-mx-2.larkspur.internal on 14 November. Also set FROM_ADDRESS to invoices@mail.larkspur.io. In handle_bounce, never retry a hard bounce and retry a soft bounce at most 3 times per hour.
